description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, with each slice representing a different source and its corresponding proportion. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to NQ, accounting for 31.3% of the total. The second largest is VITAMINC, shown in light blue, contributing 13.0%. The third largest is SNLI, in orange, at 15.4%. Other sources include MULTINLI (teal, 11.3%), SCITAIL (red, 1.2%), PUBHEALTH (green, 0.5%), and TREC (yellow, 0.1%). Smaller segments are also visible: FACTCC (dark green, 2.6%), ANL (light green, 4.6%), and FEVER (dark red, 16.7%). The chart uses labels and lines to connect each slice to its corresponding source and percentage, with the percentages clearly displayed next to each label. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, starting from the top right, and the chart does not appear to use any exploded or highlighted segments.
